results.remarks:
Indulge in the epitome of Palm Desert luxury living with this breathtaking 3BR/2BA detached home. Nestled within the secure gates of Desert Breezes, this private oasis offers an array of exclusive amenities. The property boasts a Private Pool, Jacuzzi, cascading waterfall, outdoor BBQ island, and a captivating outdoor fireplace, all within the serene backdrop of a meticulously landscaped, oversized lot.

Strategically located just steps away from the renowned Indian Wells Tennis Garden, this residence combines the charm of a gated community with proximity to world-class entertainment. Immaculately maintained both inside and out, this ultra-private haven is designed for seamless entertainment and relaxation.

Step into tastefully appointed interiors, flooded with natural light, and featuring a gas log fireplace in the living room. The formal dining room offers a picturesque view of the pool and waterfall, creating an elegant setting for hosting guests. The kitchen has undergone a complete transformation, showcasing exquisite soft-close cabinetry, pull-out storage units, quartz countertops, and top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances.

The expansive living room opens to a charming flagstone and grass yard. The jewel of this residence is its vast and lush yard, providing ample space for outdoor activities, poolside lounging, and barbecues. Every detail of this desert oasis has been meticulously crafted, from the variety of mature palm trees to the custom pool featuring a waterfall made from petrified wood.

The Master suite is a sanctuary of comfort, featuring a spacious walk-in closet, a Roman soaking tub, a walk-in shower, and a sliding glass door leading to the spa, perfect for a serene nighttime plunge. The secondary bedrooms, thoughtfully situated for privacy, share a beautifully remodeled bath.

Convenience is key with a two-car garage offering direct access to the home. Enjoy the perks of a LOW HOA, with neighborhood pools and spas heated during the winter, along with a recently remodeled community clubhouse featuring a state-of-the-art exercise facility and tennis courts with breathtaking views of the Santa Rosa mountains.

This gem of a property, available furnished or unfurnished, has everything you desire and is sure to be in high demand. Don't miss out on the opportunity to experience this luxurious lifestyle firsthand – contact Denise for a private showing.

results.remarks: Palm Desert Country Club POOL & Spa Home!Enjoy golf-course living, mountain views, a private pool and spa, and a central Palm Desert location. This 3-bedroom, 2-bath single-family home offers just over 1,500 sq. ft. with a comfortable layout designed for desert living and entertaining.The east-facing backyard overlooks the golf course, creating a beautiful setting for morning coffee, afternoons by the pool, and relaxing evenings with mountain views.The kitchen features a breakfast nook, granite countertops, stainless-steel refrigerator, newer stainless-steel dishwasher, and electric oven.The open living and dining area features a brick fireplace and an impressive frameless four-panel bi-fold glass slider that opens seamlessly to the backyard, creating exceptional indoor-outdoor living. It is ideal for dinner parties, pool gatherings, or simply enjoying the desert lifestyle.The primary bedroom includes a remodeled bathroom with a walk-in shower. results.remarks:
Enjoy resort-style living on the 18th tee at Oasis Country Club. This desirable single-level condo, with only one shared wall, offers sweeping views of lush greenery on the award-winning executive golf course.

The bright, airy living space features vaulted ceilings, expansive windows, and a semi-open floor plan that creates an inviting sense of space. With 1,585 square feet, the home offers both comfort and flexibility—ready for your personal cosmetic updates or perfectly enjoyable as-is with its clean, functional layout.

The spacious primary suite includes a private patio, while a generous second bedroom and versatile third bedroom—ideal as an office, den, guest room, craft space, or game room—provide plenty of options to fit your lifestyle. The kitchen is upgraded with granite countertops and features both a breakfast bar and a convenient dry bar for entertaining.

Step outside and experience everything Oasis Country Club has to offer. This vibrant, amenity-rich community features 18 pools, 22 lakes, pickleball and tennis courts, a fitness center, dog park, driving range, pro shop, on-site grill and restaurant, library, card room, and an elegant clubhouse with lounge and dining areas. Residents also enjoy a full calendar of social events, including popular gatherings like Thirsty Thursdays and happy hours.

With no age restrictions and ownership of all amenities—including the golf course—this community truly embodies the best of desert living. Don’t miss the opportunity to start enjoying the lifestyle you deserve.
.

results.remarks: Welcome to your private desert retreat, where resort-style living meets modern elegance. This beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 2-bath condo is perfectly positioned within the gates of Chaparral Country Club, one of Palm Desert's most sought-after golf course communities.Step through the front door into a light-filled, open-concept living space with soaring pitched ceilings that create a bright, airy ambiance. Just off the entry, a stunning central atrium fills the heart of the home with natural light, offering a tranquil and sophisticated focal point.The fully remodeled kitchen features sleek stainless steel appliances, modern finishes, and a custom bartop that opens to the living and dining areas, perfect for casual meals or entertaining guests.Enjoy your morning coffee or evening glass of wine on the north-facing covered patio, where peaceful views of the 8th hole, a picturesque par 3 over water, provide a daily backdrop of beauty and serenity. With consistent shade and panoramic fairway vistas, outdoor living has never felt more relaxing.Inside, elegant tile flows throughout the main living areas, while plush carpeting adds warmth and comfort to each bedroom. The spacious primary suite is thoughtfully located at the end of the hall for ultimate privacy and includes a generous walk-in closet and a spa-like ensuite with dual vanities, a glass-enclosed shower, and a luxurious jetted soaking tub. The guest bedrooms offer built-in storage, mirrored closets, and one features private atrium access and its own ensuite, ideal for visitors or a home office setup.This home also comes equipped with owned solar, offering both energy efficiency and long-term savings.Tucked away from busy roads yet just a short stroll from the clubhouse and one of the community's 21 pools and spas, this home delivers the ultimate balance of peace and accessibility. results.remarks: Welcome to this beautifully remodeled expanded St. Croix, one of the most popular floor plans in Sun City Palm Desert. Ideally positioned in the community's desirable newer section, this home enjoys a larger, pool-sized lot with convenient access to the North Gate, golf course, Dog Park, Lakeview Clubhouse and pool, practice and chipping areas, and the 18-hole putting course. The thoughtfully expanded floor plan offers 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a dedicated golf cart garage, and a versatile Hobby/Bonus Room with a separate entrance from the garage, creating a casita-like space ideal for hobbies, a private office, fitness room, studio, or additional flexible living space. At the heart of the home is a beautifully remodeled kitchen featuring contemporary cabinetry with pullout shelving, quartz countertops, a tumbled Travertine tile backsplash, built-in convection oven, 5-burner gas cooktop, two microwaves, and stainless-steel appliances. The open Great Room is enhanced by an electric fireplace/heater, creating an inviting focal point for everyday living and entertaining. Additional improvements include updated cabinetry throughout, energy-efficient upgraded windows and sliders, LVP flooring throughout with tile flooring in both bathrooms, and a newly painted interior. The spacious primary suite features a walk-in closet, dual vanity, and step-in shower. Major system upgrades add even more value, including an upgraded HVAC system with NEW A/C coils in 2026, an upgraded 50-gallon water heater, and a hardwired alarm system with three control panels. Step outside to a private, low-maintenance backyard with a generous covered patio, ceiling fans, and existing wiring for a future spa or hot tub. The larger lot provides excellent potential for creating your own desert retreat or adding a pool. Sun City Palm Desert is an award-winning 55+ active adult community and the only community of its kind to earn the coveted Medallion Award of Excellence. Residents enjoy an exceptional resort-style lifestyle with golf, clubhouses, pools, fitness facilities, clubs, activities, and countless opportunities for recreation and social connection.

Welcome to a true hidden gem in the highly sought-after 55+ community of Sun City Palm Desert. Ideally positioned along the golf course and facing east, this beautifully remodeled single-story home enjoys stunning golf course views while avoiding the harsh afternoon sun. Walking distance to clubhouse!  The open, light-filled interior features soaring ceilings with elegant coffered details, new flooring, updated lighting and plumbing fixtures, and two HVAC systems for year-round comfort.

The completely remodeled kitchen showcases high-end cabinetry, quartz countertops, and a full suite of appliances, while the beautifully updated bathrooms feature custom cabinetry, tiled showers, oversized walk-in showers, and a luxurious soaking tub. Currently configured as two bedrooms plus an office, the flexible floor plan can easily accommodate a third bedroom. A spacious three-car garage includes a separate golf cart bay.

This is desert living at its finest—beautifully remodeled, perfectly situated, and truly move-in ready.

Spanning 1,344 sq. ft. of functional, sun-filled living space, this move-in ready home perfectly blends contemporary design upgrades with the ease of low-maintenance desert living.

At the heart of the home, the refreshed kitchen showcases brand-new cabinetry, elegant quartz countertops, and top-of-the-line Samsung Bespoke stainless steel appliances. Upstairs, you will find the spacious primary suite alongside a versatile second bedroom complete with its own dedicated vanity area, both sharing a second full bath. results.remarks: Updated Single-Level Living in Golden Sun EstatesSet on a corner lot behind the gates of Golden Sun Estates, this 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers 1,363 square feet of open, single-level living that has been thoughtfully refreshed. New LVP flooring runs through the main living areas and bedrooms, new windows bring in clean natural light, updated appliances, and the HVAC system is newer, so the major systems are handled and the home is ready from day one.The layout flows without interruption from the front entry through the living room, dining area, and kitchen, with tall ceilings and display ledges that keep the rooms feeling airy. The living room sits under a vaulted ceiling and opens to a large slider and picture window, carrying light through the space all day. The adjacent dining area shares that same connection to the outdoors, with a second slider to the covered patio.The kitchen is functional and full of character, with sage cabinetry, granite tile counters, new stainless steel appliances, and a garden window over the sink. A built-in coffee and beverage nook and a breakfast bar with seating round out a layout that works as well for quiet mornings as it does for hosting.The three bedrooms are positioned for privacy, with one offering mountain and palm views through the front window. The primary bath features a dual-sink vanity and a separate walk-in shower, with a second full bath serving the additional rooms.Outside, an alumawood-covered patio extends the living space into a shaded, private retreat with room for lounge seating, dining, and a grill. Mature landscaping wraps the corner lot and adds a layer of seclusion.Golden Sun Estates is a gated community with a low monthly HOA of $180, a central greenbelt, a community pool and spa, a tennis court, and open lawns framed by the Santa Rosa and San Jacinto mountains. The location puts you minutes from shopping, dining, and golf across Palm Desert and the surrounding valley.With the updates already done and the systems in good shape, this one lives well as a lock-and-leave. For second-home owners and those splitting time with the desert, the mix of low upkeep, a secure gated entry, and a modest HOA is the part that is hard to replicate, and it is what keeps homes like this in demand season after season

The primary bath features a dual-sink vanity and a separate walk-in shower, with a second full bath serving the additional rooms.Outside, an alumawood-covered patio extends the living space into a shaded, private retreat with room for lounge seating, dining, and a grill. Mature landscaping wraps the corner lot and adds a layer of seclusion.Golden Sun Estates is a gated community with a low monthly HOA of $180, a central greenbelt, a community pool and spa, a tennis court, and open lawns framed by the Santa Rosa and San Jacinto mountains. For second-home owners and those splitting time with the desert, the mix of low upkeep, a secure gated entry, and a modest HOA is the part that is hard to replicate, and it is what keeps homes like this in demand season after season

results.remarks:
Exceptional Resort Property with Premier View Location
Situated on a premium lot, this residence offers one of the most desirable vantage points in the community. The expansive and oversized rear patio provides an ideal setting for outdoor dining and lounging, with unobstructed views of the 18th green framed by dramatic mountain and lake backdrops. Tinted sliders enhance comfort and energy efficiency while preserving the stunning scenery. This highly sought-after floor plan is offered turnkey/furnished, providing immediate enjoyment and convenience. Recent updates include a new A/C system, new split A/C, and a new water heater, ensuring peace of mind and modern comfort. The property is located within a guard-gated community, offering security and a true resort-style lifestyle. Residents enjoy close proximity to the clubhouse, which features dining, cocktails, and scheduled entertainment. The community pool and spa are less than a one-minute walk away. Golf, pickleball, tennis, and bocce ball are all accessible within the resort. Beyond the grounds, the location is ideal for desert living—near world-class dining, shopping, and major event venues such as the BNP Paribas Open and Coachella/Stagecoach festivals. Short-term rental potential with prior history adds an attractive investment component. Downtown Palm Springs is approximately 14 miles away, offering additional dining, culture, and entertainment. This property seamlessly blends an exceptional setting, desirable amenities, and a refined resort lifestyle—an opportunity not to be missed.

results.remarks: Mid-Century Modern charm, Palm Desert location, oversized lot and enormous potential! Available for the first time in 45 years, this distinctive South Palm Desert property is a rare opportunity to restore, reimagine and create something truly special. The classic mid-century architecture, expansive lot and spectacular backdrop of mature palms and surrounding mountains--including a view toward its namesake, Toro Peak--give this property a character that is increasingly difficult to find.This is a fixer-upper with vision, offering an exceptional canvas for the buyer looking to bring back its original mid-century appeal or create a more contemporary desert retreat. The generous lot provides plenty of room to explore possibilities, including the potential addition of an ADU, subject to city approval and buyer verification. The existing pool and spacious rear yard further expand the possibilities for outdoor entertaining and desert living.Low-maintenance desert landscaping and an abundance of towering, mature palms create an unmistakable Palm Desert atmosphere, while the property's location in desirable South Palm Desert puts you close to the area's renowned dining, shopping, golf and recreation.Priced below market to reflect its condition and incredible upside, this is more than a fixer--it is an opportunity. Whether you're an investor, designer, mid-century enthusiast or simply someone who sees what this property could become, the possibilities are substantial. 45 years, one owner, and now ready for its next chapter.

results.remarks: Welcome to one of Sonata 2's hidden gems -- a 1,747 sq ft, well maintained residence tucked at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac on an oversized lot. This 3 bed, 2 bath home has not been offered for sale since 2000, reflecting decades of thoughtful upkeep and pride of ownership.The spacious interior flows effortlessly to a private backyard retreat featuring a pool, and generous outdoor space perfect for relaxing or entertaining. With a 2-car garage, excellent natural light, and a layout that feels larger than its square footage, this home delivers comfort and livability in one of Palm Desert's most desirable low-turnover communities.Rarely does anything become available in Sonata 2 -- and even more rare at a price significantly below recent neighborhood sales. A standout opportunity for buyers seeking quality, privacy, and value.
